shortDescription: Manage Pritunl Users using the Pritunl API

options.name: organization
options.description: The name of the organization the user is part of.

options.name: pritunl_api_secret
options.description: API Secret found in Administrators > USERNAME > API Secret.

options.name: pritunl_api_token
options.description: API Token of a Pritunl admin user. It needs to be enabled in Administrators > USERNAME > Enable Token Authentication.

options.name: pritunl_url
options.description: URL and port of the Pritunl server on which the API is enabled.

options.name: state
options.description: If V(present), the module adds user O(user_name) to the Pritunl O(organization). If V(absent), removes the user O(user_name) from the Pritunl O(organization).

options.name: user_email
options.description: Email address associated with the user O(user_name).

options.name: user_gravatar
options.description: Enable/Disable Gravatar usage for the user O(user_name).

options.name: user_groups
options.description: List of groups associated with the user O(user_name).

options.name: user_mac_addresses
options.description: Allowed MAC addresses for the user O(user_name).

options.name: user_name
options.description: Name of the user to create or delete from Pritunl.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If certificates should be validated or not. This should never be set to V(false), except if you are very sure that your connection to the server can not be subject to a Man In The Middle attack.
